name: chatcut-desktop
description: Edit videos with AI in ChatCut from your agent: install ChatCut Desktop, cut footage, add captions, clean up talking-head recordings, recreate viral videos with your own footage, and keep editing existing ChatCut Web projects.

interface.longDescription: Edit videos with AI in ChatCut: ask in your own words to install ChatCut Desktop, cut footage, add captions and subtitles, clean up a talking-head recording, add B-roll, music and motion graphics, recreate a viral video's shots and pacing with your own footage, or keep editing an existing ChatCut Web project. The plugin installs and connects the signed ChatCut Desktop app, which keeps projects on your computer.
defaultPrompt: Recreate this viral video with my own footage, keeping its shots and pacing.
Cut this talking-head video tighter and add captions.
